You are a business development manager for TechStore Online, an e-commerce company selling consumer electronics and accessories. Your task is to plan a product roadshow in Shanghai and Guangzhou to meet regional distributors, selecting the right products to demonstrate based on store sales data, arranging train travel from Beijing, building a comprehensive roadshow plan spreadsheet, documenting the plan in the company knowledge base, and notifying all key contacts.

Start by analyzing the online store data. Retrieve the top ten products by sales volume from the product sales report. For each of the top five products, get the full product details including name, price, category, and stock status. Then retrieve the customer list and examine the billing location information to understand regional customer distribution. Also pull the orders report to understand regional revenue patterns. Per the company's strategic direction, the roadshow will focus on Shanghai and Guangzhou; use the customer and orders analysis to prepare the regional overview and mark Shanghai and Guangzhou as Priority 1 in the plan.

Next, plan the train travel. Look up the station codes for Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou using the train booking system. Query available high-speed trains from Beijing South station to Shanghai Hongqiao station on March 10, 2026, and from Beijing South to Guangzhou South on the same day. Review the options for each leg and pick one suitable for arriving in time for the afternoon meetings. The roadshow configuration file in your workspace lists the preferred trains for both legs; use those selections so the itinerary aligns with the company's standing travel preferences.

Create an Excel workbook named Roadshow_Plan.xlsx in your workspace. It must contain four sheets. The first sheet should be named Products and contain columns: Product_ID, Name, Category, Price_USD, Stock_Status, and Monthly_Sales_Est. Populate it with the five products selected for demonstration. The second sheet should be named Customer_Regions and contain columns: Region, Customer_Count, Revenue_Share_Pct, and Priority. Add rows for the key regions identified in the customer data analysis, marking Shanghai and Guangzhou as Priority 1. The third sheet should be named Travel_Itinerary and contain columns: Date, Train_No, From, To, Depart, Arrive, Duration_Hours, and Purpose. Add a row for the journey to Shanghai on March 10 and a row for the journey to Guangzhou. The fourth sheet should be named Roadshow_Schedule and contain columns: City, Date, Venue, Meeting_Type, Key_Contacts, and Status. Add at least four rows covering the Shanghai meeting on March 10 and the Guangzhou meeting on March 11. Write all numeric values (prices, counts, percentages, durations) as literal numbers in the cells; do not use spreadsheet formulas.

Create a page in the company knowledge base titled "Product Roadshow 2026 - Shanghai and Guangzhou". Add a section highlighting the five demonstration products with key selling points for each. Add a travel itinerary section showing both train journeys with departure and arrival details. Add a checklist section called "Follow-up Actions" listing items such as sending product catalogs to distributors, collecting distributor feedback forms, and scheduling follow-up calls.

Send an email to shanghai_dist@partner.com with subject "Roadshow Meeting Confirmation - Shanghai March 10" providing full details of the planned meeting time, venue, and products to be demonstrated. Send a second email to guangzhou_dist@partner.com with subject "Roadshow Meeting Confirmation - Guangzhou March 11" with the Guangzhou meeting details and a list of products. Send a summary email to manager@company.com with subject "Roadshow Plan Summary - Shanghai and Guangzhou March 2026" attaching a brief overview of the itinerary, the five products selected, and the expected business outcomes.

Configuration for this task is in roadshow_config.json and the planning methodology guide is in business_guide.md, both in your workspace.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, use exactly one read-only source wave. Before dispatch, the main agent reads `roadshow_config.json` and `business_guide.md` and freezes the preferred train displays, two-city schedule, three exact email pairs, and output schemas.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 2 explore sub-agents in parallel:

   1. explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): The WooCommerce explore sub-agent calls `woo_reports_top_sellers` once, retrieves the exact top-five products by ID with one `woo_products_get` call per ID, and fully paginates only `woo_customers_list` and `woo_orders_list` at `perPage=100`. Omit the optional order status field to request the unfiltered collection, aggregate every observed status locally, and return only the five product rows plus compact Shanghai/Guangzhou customer-count, order-revenue, share, page, and join controls. Do not write files or modify the store.
   2. explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 0): The rail explore sub-agent resolves Beijing South, Shanghai Hongqiao, and Guangzhou South codes, queries both 2026-03-10 high-speed routes, and returns the exact task-configured preferred trains with display train number, route identifier where required, departure, arrival, duration, and first-class evidence. Do not write files.

After Wave 1, the main agent validates the two compact handoffs once and directly owns all outputs. Create `Roadshow_Plan.xlsx` with exactly the four required sheets, five products, both configured train rows, and at least four city schedule rows using literal numeric values. In an independent branch, exact-title search and create/update at most one `Product Roadshow 2026 - Shanghai and Guangzhou` page with the five product selling points, both train legs, and `Follow-up Actions`. Read the workbook and page once, then send at most one missing message for each of the three exact recipient/subject pairs. Do not dispatch a writer or verification wave.

nodes.text:
You are helping TechStore Online (a WooCommerce-based e-commerce store selling consumer electronics and accessories) prepare for a product roadshow in Shanghai and Guangzhou. Your job is to gather and analyze read-only store data from the WooCommerce MCP tools (mcp__woocommerce__*). Do NOT create, update, or delete anything — read-only.

Gather the following:

1. TOP PRODUCTS BY SALES VOLUME:
   - Retrieve the top-selling products report (use mcp__woocommerce__woo_reports_top_sellers, and if useful mcp__woocommerce__woo_reports_products, with perPage=100). Identify the TOP TEN products ranked by total sales volume (units sold / quantity, not revenue).
   - For each of the top ten, capture: product ID, name, and the sales volume metric.
   - Then for the TOP FIVE products by sales volume, retrieve full product details (mcp__woocommerce__woo_products_get) and report: Product_ID, Name, Category (from categories list), Price (regular/sale price, in USD as listed), Stock_Status (instock/outofstock/etc.), and stock quantity if available.
   - Estimate monthly sales for each of the top five (use the sales volume data; if the report gives totals for a period, note the period and derive a reasonable monthly estimate).

2. CUSTOMER REGIONAL DISTRIBUTION:
   - Retrieve the customer list (mcp__woocommerce__woo_customers_list, perPage=100, paginate through all pages).
   - Examine each customer's billing address (billing city/state/country) and count customers per region (city or province). Report the count per region.

3. ORDERS REGIONAL REVENUE PATTERNS:
   - Pull the orders (mcp__woocommerce__woo_orders_list, perPage=100, paginate all pages; include statuses completed/processing if useful) and/or the sales report (mcp__woocommerce__woo_reports_sales, mcp__woocommerce__woo_reports_orders).
   - Determine total revenue and revenue per region based on billing location (city/province) of orders. Compute each region's revenue share as a percentage of total revenue.
   - Classification rule: regions with revenue share >20% = Priority 1; 10–20% = Priority 2. Identify which regions qualify and specifically confirm whether Shanghai and Guangzhou appear as significant regions.

DELIVERABLES (return in your final report, structured):
- Top 10 products list: Product_ID | Name | Sales_Volume.
- Top 5 product details table: Product_ID | Name | Category | Price_USD | Stock_Status | Monthly_Sales_Est (with the basis for the monthly estimate).
- Customer count per region (city/province) table.
- Revenue per region + revenue share % + Priority classification table, with total revenue stated.
- Any caveats about data (e.g., empty billing fields, currency).
Analyze WooCommerce store data

You are creating a page in TechStore Online's Notion knowledge base for the 2026 Shanghai & Guangzhou product roadshow. Use the mcp__notion__API-* tools (write tools only — creating/updating pages and blocks is your job).

STEP 1 — Find/create the right location:
- Search Notion (mcp__notion__API-post-search) for an existing page titled "Product Roadshow 2026 - Shanghai and Guangzhou". If one already exists, do NOT create a duplicate — use the existing page (report its ID and update it).
- If it does not exist, look for any existing "Knowledge Base" page/database to use as parent. If none is found, create the page as a top-level page: first try parent {"type": "workspace", "workspace": true}; if the API rejects that, use parent page_id "page-sprint12-154af770" (an existing page in the workspace). 

STEP 2 — Create the page with title: "Product Roadshow 2026 - Shanghai and Guangzhou" and add content blocks via mcp__notion__API-patch-block-children (or pass children at creation). Content to include:

A) Heading "Demonstration Products" with a bullet for each of the five products and its key selling point:
- NIHARA Wood Smart Multipurpose Foldable Laptop Table (Black) — Ergonomic foldable laptop table with cup holder and rounded edges; a top home-office/remote-work accessory with the store's highest sales volume.
- (Renewed) JBL Flip 4 Portable Wireless Speaker (Squad) — Portable Bluetooth speaker with powerful bass and built-in microphone; strong brand recognition in the wireless audio line.
- LIMBANI BROTHERS Automatic Vacuum Sealing Machine — Seals flatbreads, nuts, vegetables and fruits to preserve freshness; a high-demand home appliance.
- Oraimo 25.5W 4 Ports USB Charger (5.1A) — Multi-port wall charger for phones/tablets; essential mobile accessory with a 5.0 customer rating.
- Oppo Enco Air 3 True Wireless Earbuds (Glaze White) — 25-hour playtime, fast charging, 13.4mm driver, Bluetooth 5.3; flagship wireless audio product.

B) Heading "Travel Itinerary" with details of both journeys:
- G11: 2026-03-10, Beijing South 07:00 -> Shanghai Hongqiao 12:31 (duration 5h31m), first class — for the Shanghai meeting on March 10.
- G105: 2026-03-10, Beijing South 08:00 -> Guangzhou South 15:48 (duration 7h48m), first class — for the Guangzhou meeting on March 11.

C) Heading "Follow-up Actions" as a checklist (use to_do blocks, unchecked):
- Send product catalogs and pricing sheets to Shanghai and Guangzhou distributors.
- Collect distributor feedback forms after each meeting.
- Schedule follow-up calls with both distributors (two weeks after the roadshow).
- Send meeting notes, product specification sheets and proposed distributor terms within 48 hours of each meeting.

STEP 3 — Verify: retrieve the created page (mcp__notion__API-retrieve-a-page) and its block children, then report back the page ID, page URL, and confirm the title and all three sections (Demonstration Products, Travel Itinerary, Follow-up Actions checklist) are present.
Create Notion roadshow page

You are sending three emails for TechStore Online's 2026 Shanghai & Guangzhou product roadshow using the mcp__emails__* tools (send_email). The email server is already connected. Send all three emails exactly as specified below. Use plain text bodies (html_body optional).

- Five demonstration products (top 5 by sales volume): 
  1) NIHARA Wood Smart Multipurpose Foldable Laptop Table (Black) — Electronics, $2.64

- Meetings: Shanghai on 2026-03-10, 14:00-17:00, venue "Shanghai Distribution Office". Guangzhou on 2026-03-11 (full day starting 09:00), venue "Guangzhou Distribution Office".
- Travel costs (first class, CNY): G11 Beijing-Shanghai 553 yuan; G105 Beijing-Guangzhou 862.5 yuan; total 1415.5 yuan.
- The Excel workbook exists at: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-12306-wc-amazon-product-roadshow-excel-notion/workspace/Roadshow_Plan.xlsx (use this absolute path for the attachment).

EMAIL 1 — To: shanghai_dist@partner.com

Note the team travels by train G105 (Beijing South 08:00 -> Guangzhou South 15:48 on March 10) and is available for a full-day session on March 11. Mention a product catalog and pricing sheet will be provided.

ATTACH the file /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-12306-wc-amazon-product-roadshow-excel-notion/workspace/Roadshow_Plan.xlsx to this email using the attachments parameter.
